digest.component_or_area: test-harness: Anthropic auth validation held-out tests
propositions: Three held-out test nodes replace anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with function doubles before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is imported, causing a TypeError at the provider's runtime TypeAlias union evaluation instead of reaching the intended secret-redaction LLMConfigError.

The defect is test-isolation (test-double representation), not production auth validation; production semantics correctly validate before client construction, and the test-double must preserve the SDK symbol's class contract.

Replacing the three function-shaped doubles with class-shaped doubles that retain fail-if-constructed tripwires restores the intended test behavior without pre-importing the provider or changing production source.

A child-process oracle was added to force a fresh provider import and assert the secret-free conflict error; it was observed RED (3 failures at union TypeError, 1 pass) before repair and GREEN (4 passes) after, then RED again when the exact function patch was reintroduced.
